summary: Completed full testing of Canva Director feature. Backend APIs (config GET/PUT, auth/status, auth/url, activity) all working. Fixed frontend issue: CanvaDirectorPage.js was missing X-Main-Site-ID header in API calls. After fix, configuration saves successfully and all UI components work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CanvaDirectorPage.js was missing X-Main-Site-ID header in all API calls. Added mainSite.id to headers object and added mainSite?.id to useCallback dependencies to ensure headers are rebuilt when mainSite context is available.
canva.py: Well-structured router with proper async DB operations, config masking, OAuth state management, and activity logging
server.py: canva_router correctly registered on line 140
models/main_sites.py: canva_director feature defined on line 46
MainSiteDashboardLayout.js: canva_director in FEATURE_NAV_ITEMS (line 89) and NAV_GROUPS server group (line 136)
seed_data_creation: Temporarily enabled demo mode on clara-xml-server for testing. Disabled after tests completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canva Director feature fully implemented and tested. The feature is available on server-type sites with canva_director enabled. API endpoints require X-Main-Site-ID header. Testing site: clara-xml-server (9d51a9a0-90ea-41c5-8324-d240fedbd99c). The actual Canva OAuth flow requires real Canva credentials - only local config/status endpoints were tested.

Backend_GET_canva_config.details: Returns configured=false initially, configured=true with masked secret after PUT

Backend_PUT_canva_config.details: Saves client_id, client_secret (masked on GET), redirect_uri

Backend_GET_canva_auth_status.details: Returns connected=false when no token exists

Backend_GET_canva_auth_url.details: Returns 400 when not configured, returns Canva OAuth URL when configured

Frontend_CanvaDirector_page_loads.details: Shows 'Canva Director' header with subtitle, 3 tabs (Designs, Activity, Configuration)

Frontend_not_configured_warning.details: Shows 'Canva not configured' warning with 'Configure Now' button when not configured

Frontend_configuration_form.details: Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI fields and Save Configuration button present

Frontend_save_config_success.details: Configuration saves successfully, shows success toast and 'Canva API configured' badge

Frontend_connect_canva_prompt.details: After config saved, Designs tab shows 'Connect your Canva account' prompt with 'Connect Canva' button

Frontend_sidebar_icon.details: Canva Director (Palette icon) visible in sidebar for server sites with canva_director feature enabled

bug_fixed.issue: Frontend API calls failing with 400 errors
bug_fixed.root_cause: CanvaDirectorPage.js was not including X-Main-Site-ID header in fetch calls
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added mainSite.id to headers object when mainSite is available, added mainSite?.id to useCallback dependencies
